new_blocker_high_medium_findings.cause: No durable apply-state/ownership journal or recovery independent of the modifying administrator session
new_blocker_high_medium_findings.static_reproduction: Create/start bench slice; successfully restrict user.slice and machine.slice; lose admin session or kill orchestration before next command. Nonzero-command handling is never reached, no scheduled recovery or committed operation log exists.
new_blocker_high_medium_findings.impact: Shared editor/Codex/services remain under a partially applied placement indefinitely; recovery cannot safely distinguish applied, unknown-in-flight or concurrent administrative changes.
new_blocker_high_medium_findings.minimal_fix: Before first mutation, root-controlled durable baseline/ownership manifest and serialized maintenance lock; write-ahead intent and readback per operation; exact idempotent partial/crash recovery algorithm with separate privileged recovery path/watchdog and tested cancellation/disarm conditions. Abort on concurrent drift; do not retry mutations blindly.

new_blocker_high_medium_findings.cause: Exact runtime property-fragment ownership/restoration is deferred; final daemon-reload occurs before later fragment restoration/removal
new_blocker_high_medium_findings.static_reproduction: Baseline has no DropInPaths. set-property creates runtime fragments. Rollback set-property AllowedCPUs= creates/changes fragments too. Listed daemon-reload runs after bench-unit deletion, then text instructs restoring/removing property files without a further mandatory reload. Runtime readback may show empty AllowedCPUs while on-disk ownership/parity is unresolved.
new_blocker_high_medium_findings.impact: No executable proof that only owned files are removed/restored, manager state agrees with restored files, or pre-existing/concurrent runtime configuration survives; false baseline recovery can be claimed.
new_blocker_high_medium_findings.minimal_fix: Freeze actual set-property fragment discovery/write locations and a root-owned allowlist before application; record pre/post bytes/hashes/ownership (including rollback writes); restore only owned exact deltas, refuse unknown changes, then daemon-reload once after all file restoration and verify FragmentPath/DropInPaths, Allowed/Startup/effective CPUs and file parity. Require an explicit empty-descendant check before stopping bench slice.
